quote: A lead technician whose Time Clock is turned off (not deleted) keeps their own column on Board View and group in Tech View, under their name, while they still lead work orders. Nothing can be dropped onto it, the same as S3-R20c. Once they lead no work orders, the column or group is no longer shown.

The column of S3-R20b takes no drops. Dropping a work order on it is refused with "This technician can't be assigned work orders." and the work order stays where it was. The column shows no inactive marker, because the technician is not deactivated (S3-N4). Once it holds no work orders, the column is no longer shown.
Nothing can be dropped onto the column/group of an inactive technician (S2-N2, S3-N2) or of a technician who is not enrolled at this location (S3-R20c).

When no filter and no search are active and the filter view has no work orders at all, Tech View and Board View show the design’s first-run state: the clipboard-list icon in a grey circle, “No work orders yet”, then “Create a work order and assign a technician to see it here.”, with a Create Work Order button that does the same as the page’s Create Work Order button. List keeps its production empty state.

In Tech View and Board View, as in the design: a technician avatar without a photo is a light-grey circle (--sv-grey-100, #EEF2F6) with initials in --sv-grey-600 (#4B5565) in light mode, which meets accessible contrast (6.7:1; the design file’s #697586 is 4.2:1); dark mode uses the design’s dark colors; group and column header names are 14px, weight 600, in the design’s slate text color (#364152), with the design’s smaller, lighter initials; Board card customer and total price are weight 500; toolbar and switcher icons are the design’s slate color (the switcher in List too, S1-R9a). Technician avatars, and the Service Advisor avatar, follow density in Tech View as in the design: 20px, 24px and 32px on rows and 24px, 28px and 36px on group headers at Compact, Regular and Comfortable; Board View card avatars stay 24px. The Progress bar is 48 by 4px at Compact, as in the design. The name bubble on hover over a technician avatar on a row or card (the +N included) opens above the avatar, in both views; group and column header avatars keep the browser’s plain name tip, because the name is printed beside them. In Tech View, Status, Waiting On Parts and Progress are left-aligned. The Density and Columns tooltips open above their button, like the switcher’s (S1-R9b), and are hidden while their menu is open. List is unchanged.
The switcher’s hover tooltip opens above the switcher, so it never covers the table’s column header row. The tooltips read List, Tech View and Board View.
